title: How do you know it's going to rain?
scene: 他问爸爸怎么预判下雨。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: How do you know it's going to rain?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: The sky's getting dark and heavy.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: The clouds hold water, and they look heavy.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: How do you know all this?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: I've watched a lot of skies.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: So the sky is a big puddle?
